name: icims tenant: http upgraded, host lower-cased, query dropped, path after id
spec: `https://<tenant>.icims.com/jobs/<digits>/<anything>` (any path after the id, any query) → `["icims", "https://<tenant>.icims.com/jobs/<digits>/login"]`. The host is lower-cased; `http://` becomes `https://`; the query string is dropped.

name: jibe apply front end passes url through unchanged
spec: A Jibe front end `https://<x>.jibeapply.com/jobs/<digits>…` → `["jibe", <the url unchanged>]`.

name: non-icims host with exactly icims=1 is a jibe front end
spec: Any other host whose path starts `/jobs/<digits>` AND whose query has `icims=1` as one of its parameters (e.g. `https://careers.medpace.com/jobs/13026?icims=1`) → `["jibe", <url unchanged>]`.

name: near miss: icims=10 on non-icims host is not a jibe front end
spec: `icims=10` or `xicims=1` do not count. ... Anything else ... → `[null, null]`.

name: login.icims.com is not a tenant
spec: `login.icims.com` is not a tenant: → `[null, null]`.

name: profile field override wins over label, with numeric prefix
spec: When `fid` contains `PersonProfileFields.<Name>` or `PortalProfileFields.<Name>` (an optional prefix like `-1_` may come first) and `<Name>` (case-insensitive) is one of: PhoneType → "Phone Device Type" ... — return that, whatever the label says.

name: profile field name matched case-insensitively, overriding a different label
spec: `<Name>` (case-insensitive) is one of: ... LastName → "Last Name" — return that, whatever the label says.

name: fallback label cleanup: asterisk and trailing 'required.'
spec: Otherwise return the label with whitespace collapsed, a trailing "required." / "required" word removed, and a leading or trailing `*` removed, then trimmed. Example: "Are you 18 or older?*  required." → "Are you 18 or older?".

name: fallback label cleanup: whitespace collapse and trailing 'required' without period
args: Please  confirm your mailing address required
spec: Otherwise return the label with whitespace collapsed, a trailing "required." / "required" word removed, and a leading or trailing `*` removed, then trimmed.

name: standard step bar with Current on step 1 and two of four steps shown
args: Step 1 of 4. Candidate Profile(Current Step) Step 2 of 4. Candidate Questions(Incomplete Step)
spec: `steps` = list of the step names in order 1..total ("" for a number that does not appear); `current` = the number whose state is Current; `name` = its name; `total` = the largest "of N".

name: near miss: step bar with no Current step yields null
args: Step 1 of 4. Candidate Profile(Complete Step) Step 2 of 4. Candidate Questions(Incomplete Step)
spec: No step bar, or no step marked Current → null.

name: no step bar at all yields null
spec: No step bar, or no step marked Current → null.

name: Current on final step, other step numbers absent
spec: `steps` = list of the step names in order 1..total ("" for a number that does not appear); `current` = the number whose state is Current; `name` = its name; `total` = the largest "of N".

name: lowercase state words, three steps, current is step 1
args: Step 1 of 3. Profile(current step) Step 2 of 3. Questions(incomplete step) Step 3 of 3. Review(complete step)
spec: the state in brackets is one of Current / Incomplete / Complete / Completed followed by "Step" (case-insensitive)

name: current equals total, even with a non-submit button text
spec: True (pressing the button may hand in the application) when ANY of: 1. steps.current ≥ steps.total;

name: second-to-last step whose last step name contains 'Confirm'
spec: 2. steps.current = steps.total − 1 and the last step's name contains (case-insensitive) assessment, review, confirm, submit, e-sign / esign, signature, complete or thank;

name: near miss: second-to-last step but last step is 'Candidate Questions'
spec: Otherwise false — e.g. "Submit Profile", "Next", "Save & Continue" on step 1 of 4 whose last step is "Candidate Questions".

name: near miss: 'Submit Profile' on step 1 of 4 is not final
spec: Otherwise false — e.g. "Submit Profile", "Next", "Save & Continue" on step 1 of 4 whose last step is "Candidate Questions".

name: 'Submit Application' matches button-text rule regardless of step position
spec: 3. the button text matches (case-insensitive) "submit application", "submit my application", "submit your application", "finish", "complete application" (also with my / your), "apply now", "send application", or is exactly "Submit";

name: social login button skipped, first qualifying button returned
spec: Return the FIRST button whose text (non-empty) does NOT match any of: "log in with", ... apple ... — AND does match one of: the word "next", "continue", "submit", ...

name: all buttons excluded yields null
spec: … or exactly "search" (all case-insensitive) — AND does match one of: … None qualifies → null.

name: exact 'Search' skipped, 'Next' selected
spec: Return the FIRST button whose text (non-empty) does NOT match any of: ... or exactly "search" (all case-insensitive) — AND does match one of: the word "next", ...

name: empty text and 'Continue with LinkedIn' skipped, 'Finish' selected
spec: Return the FIRST button whose text (non-empty) does NOT match any of: "log in with", "login with", "sign in with", "signin with", "continue with", "connect", google, facebook, linkedin / linked in, ... — AND does match one of: ... "proceed", "finish", "apply".

name: login.icims.com with wrong-password text
spec: 1. url contains `login.icims.com`: text says "wrong email or password", "wrong username or password", "incorrect username/email/password" or the Chinese ... → "bad_password";

name: login.icims.com with /password url and no credential-error text
spec: else url contains `/password` → "universal_password";

name: login.icims.com plain page, no error text, no /password
spec: else "universal_login".

name: social account login failure text
args: Unable to log in with the social account.
spec: 2. text contains "unable to log in with the social account" → "social_error".

name: near miss: thank-you text that also shows a step bar is a form, not done
args: Thank you for applying! Step 3 of 4. Candidate Questions
spec: 3. text says the application / submission has been (or was) (successfully) submitted / received / complete, or "thank you for applying / your application / submitting" — and the text has NO "Step N of M" → "done". 4. text has "Step N of M" ... → "form".

name: successful submission with no step bar
args: Your application has been successfully submitted.
spec: 3. text says the application / submission has been (or was) (successfully) submitted / received / complete ... and the text has NO "Step N of M" → "done".

name: /login url with no other signals
spec: 5. url contains `/login` or text says "enter your email" / "enter your information" → "email".
